findings.claim: Normative resource accounting is performed after resource-consuming work or is not integrated.
findings.evidence: Malformed over-limit input can raise JSONDecodeError with an empty trace; temporary units and schema/format/ref charge events have no production integration.
findings.required_change: Implement work-before-charge ordering, temporary lifetimes, recursive inline tracing, and exhaustive boundary tests.

findings.claim: Draft 2020-12 unevaluated annotation propagation is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Successful allOf/ref/contains evaluations do not contribute evaluated property/item annotations.
findings.required_change: Propagate annotations across every frozen applicator and add independent positive/reject vectors.

findings.claim: The built-in executable registry permits arbitrary callable injection and lacks digest/code binding.
findings.evidence: PredicateSpec accepts caller-supplied Callable and the manifest has no registry or implementation digest.
findings.required_change: Load a digest-locked closed built-in registry and reject injection, override, and tamper.

findings.claim: Error rules do not constrain code/phase/rule combinations.
findings.evidence: Semantically illegal cross-combinations pass registry require().
findings.required_change: Digest-lock exact code/phase/rule triples and reject all invalid combinations.

findings.claim: The migration transform registry, unique path, pure execution, and provenance contract are absent.
findings.evidence: Only a directional compatibility matrix exists.
findings.required_change: Implement immutable built-in transforms, unique-path enforcement, digest/cost/capability binding, and byte-identical provenance.

findings.claim: Cross-implementation coverage is too small for the WP-01 exit contract.
findings.evidence: Only 4 canonical, 3 successful GEEL, and 3 basic schema cases run, without exact errors, traces, registries, projections, or migration.
findings.required_change: Cover the complete GEW-CON-001..250 domains with unique stable IDs and exact cross-implementation outcomes.

findings.claim: Validated production objects retain mutable nested aliases.
findings.evidence: ResourceProfile.limits, CostSchedule.coefficients, GEEL expression, schema resources, predicate multipliers, and self-digest nested values remain mutable.
findings.required_change: Deep-copy/freeze all ingress and return fresh thawed output with mutation tests.
